key_idea: Follow the paper one fold at a time and keep track of which square is on top.
steps: Fold 1: the right half goes on top of the left half. Now 8 is on top of 5, and 2 is on top of 3.
Fold 2: the bottom pile flips up onto the top pile. It turns over, so 3 ends up on top and 2 is under it.
From the top, the layers are 3, 2, 8, 5. The 2 is in the 2nd layer.

choice_feedback.A: 3 is on top, because the bottom pile turns over when it is folded up.
choice_feedback.D: 5 never moves, so it is in the bottom layer.
choice_feedback.E: Every digit stays inside the folded paper.
